Use when: status, drift or traceability (read-only)

How to run this playbook:
- Follow steps in order. CALL sends the shown arguments; RUN executes a command. FOR EACH repeats its indented lines.
- Replace `<input:x>` from You need, `<saved:x>` from SAVE, `<each:x>` from the current item. Whole placeholders retain their JSON type, including numbers, arrays, objects and null; embedded ones are text. Never invent concurrency tokens. `result` is the last call's response.
- IF tests a condition; go to step N jumps forward; go to Answer ends execution.
- ASK waits for the user's answer unless that exact action is already authorized. STOP ends calls and puts its message in Next. Owner-only actions require the owner's order.
- VERIFY must pass before reporting success. Fill the Answer block in the user's language; copy IDs exactly. Secrets never enter the reply. **Your entire reply is ONLY the Answer block — no other text.**

### You need
| Input | Where it comes from | If missing |
|---|---|---|
| projectId | the user | STOP. Say: "Which LPM project? (id or name)" |
| question | "traceability" if the user asks which requirements have no delivery or which links are stale, else "status" | "status" |

### Steps
Every CALL with no error line: IF it returns an error → STOP. Say: "Scope check incomplete: <tool> failed: <error text>."
1. CALL `get_mcp_connection_info` {} [A]
   IF result.credential == "oauth" → STOP. Say: "On a ChatGPT/Claude connector only the project execution context is readable; scope details need an LPM API key."
2. CALL `get_project_scope_resolution_context` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>"} [A]
   SAVE: baselineId, baselineVersion = id and version of result.currentBaseline (both "none" if null); added = result.workingScope.addedCount; changed = result.workingScope.changedCount; affected = result.workingScope.affectedCount; orphans = result.requirementsAwaitingBaseline.count; blocked = result.publicationGate.shouldBlockPublication; matchedId = result.publicationGate.matchedApprovedChangeSetId; materiality = result.publicationGate.materiality; reasons = result.publicationGate.reasonCodes
   IF <input:question> == "traceability" and <saved:baselineId> != "none" → go to step 5.
   IF <saved:affected> == 0 → SAVE: delta = "none"; go to Answer.
3. CALL `list_working_scope_delta_entities` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","changeType":"added","limitCount":100} [A]
   SAVE: delta = "<requirementId> <title> (added, <changedAt>)" for each item; more = "yes" if result.nextCursor is not empty
4. CALL `list_working_scope_delta_entities` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","changeType":"changed","limitCount":100} [A]
   SAVE: delta = <saved:delta> plus "<requirementId> <title> (changed, <changedAt>)" for each item; more = "yes" if result.nextCursor is not empty; go to Answer.
5. CALL `list_requirements` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","baselineId":"<saved:baselineId>"} [A]
   SAVE: reqs = id, title, status, issueId, linkedIssueIds, linkedCycleIds, linkedMilestoneIds of each item; noDelivery = "<id> <title>" of each item with empty issueId, linkedIssueIds, linkedCycleIds and linkedMilestoneIds
6. CALL `list_issues` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>"} [A] (no limitCount: it returns every issue)
   SAVE: stale = "<requirement id> → <issue id> (<issue status or missing>)" for each linkedIssueIds id of <saved:reqs> whose issue is missing, or is "done" or "canceled" while the requirement status is "pending"
   SAVE: delta = "not read (traceability question)"

### Answer (reply with exactly this block, filled in; write nothing before or after it)
```text
Scope: <input:projectId>; baseline <saved:baselineVersion> (<saved:baselineId>)
Done: read-only check, nothing changed; added <saved:added>, changed <saved:changed>, orphans <saved:orphans>
Evidence: <publication not blocked (materiality <saved:materiality>) | publication blocked: <saved:reasons>, matched change set <saved:matchedId>>; delta: <saved:delta> | traceability: no delivery: <saved:noDelivery>; stale links: <saved:stale>
Pending: removals are never shown by the delta (removedCount is always 0) | <more than 100 items in a delta list> | none
Next: <the ASK or STOP text that ended the run> | create a change set for owner review (playbook change-set) | attach orphans (playbook groups-and-orphans) | the owner orders publication (playbook publish-baseline) | none
```
materiality: none | low | medium | high. Reason codes: cost-threshold (forecast cost ≥ 1000), schedule-threshold (cycles + milestones ≥ 2), scope-threshold (≥ 4 requirements), delivery-threshold (≥ 3 linked issues), activity-threshold (≥ 3 activities), scope-without-delivery (a requirement with no linked issue, cycle or milestone). Medium or high needs a change set approved by the owner before publication; low or none needs none. Never claim "no removals" and never claim a check that a step above did not run.

### Steps
Every CALL with no error line: IF it returns an error → STOP. Say: "<tool> failed: <error text>. Nothing was changed."

2. CALL `get_project_scope_resolution_context` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>"} [A]
   SAVE: baselineId, version, baselineCreatedAt = id, version, createdAt of result.currentBaseline
3. CALL `list_requirements` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","baselineId":"<saved:baselineId>"} [A]
   SAVE: requirementId = id of the only item whose id or title == <input:requirement>; title, description, type, status, groupId, issueId, linkedIssueIds, linkedCycleIds, linkedMilestoneIds = those fields of that item; approved = "yes" if its createdAt <= <saved:baselineCreatedAt>, else "no"

   GO TO step 7

   IF an item has status neither "resolved" nor "closed" → STOP. Say: "Thread <that id> already asks the owner about <saved:requirementId>. Nothing was changed."

   ```text
   Options: A) apply it — the working scope changes and the next publication may need a reviewed change set; B) keep the approved text.
   Recommendation: A, because the requester asked for it; the owner decides.
   ```
6. CALL `create_governance_thread` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","targetType":"requirement","targetId":"<saved:requirementId>","title":"Change approved requirement <saved:title>","content":"<saved:content>"} [A]
   SAVE: threadId = the id after "ID: "
   VERIFY: CALL `list_governance_threads` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","targetType":"requirement","targetId":"<saved:requirementId>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or no item has id == <saved:threadId> → STOP. Say: "Thread <saved:threadId> is not listed."
   SAVE: outcome = "thread <saved:threadId> opened; requirement unchanged"; go to Answer.
7. CALL `list_issues` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>"} [A] (no limitCount: it returns every issue)
   SAVE: issueIds = <saved:linkedIssueIds> plus the id of the only issue whose id or title == each name in <input:link>, minus those named in <input:unlink>; issueId = <saved:issueId> if still in <saved:issueIds>, else its first id, else ""
   IF a name matches no issue or 2+ issues → STOP. Say: "Which activity is '<that name>'?"
   IF <input:newStatus> == "met" and <input:ownerOrder> == "none" and <saved:issueIds>, <saved:linkedCycleIds> and <saved:linkedMilestoneIds> are all empty → STOP. Say: "Not met yet: no linked delivery."
   IF <input:newStatus> == "met" and <input:ownerOrder> == "none" and an id of <saved:issueIds> has status != "done" → STOP. Say: "Not met yet: <that id> is <its status>."
8. CALL `list_requirement_groups` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>"} [A]
   SAVE: groupId = id of the only item whose name == <input:newGroup> when it is not "none", else <saved:groupId> ("" if null)
   IF <input:newGroup> != "none" and no item matches → STOP. Say: "No group named '<input:newGroup>' (playbook groups-and-orphans creates it)."
   SAVE: sendTitle, sendDescription, sendType, sendStatus = <input:newTitle>, <input:newDescription>, <input:newType>, <input:newStatus> where not "none", else <saved:title>, <saved:description>, <saved:type>, <saved:status>
9. ASK: "Update <saved:requirementId>: title '<saved:sendTitle>', type <saved:sendType>, status <saved:sendStatus>, group <saved:groupId>, activities <saved:issueIds>, description <changed or unchanged>? Intent: refinement. This changes the working scope; it is approved only when a baseline is published. (yes/no)" — continue only if the user says yes; otherwise STOP.
10. CALL `update_requirement` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","requirementId":"<saved:requirementId>","title":"<saved:sendTitle>","description":"<saved:sendDescription>","type":"<saved:sendType>","status":"<saved:sendStatus>","groupId":"<saved:groupId>","issueId":"<saved:issueId>","linkedIssueIds":["<saved:issueIds>"]} [C] (the array holds every id of <saved:issueIds>, [] if none; "" clears)
   VERIFY: CALL `list_requirements` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","baselineId":"<saved:baselineId>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or item <saved:requirementId> does not show every sent value → STOP. Say: "<saved:requirementId> does not show the sent values."
   SAVE: outcome = "requirement <saved:requirementId> updated"

### Answer (reply with exactly this block, filled in; write nothing before or after it)
```text
Scope: <input:projectId>; baseline <saved:version> (<saved:baselineId>); requirement <saved:requirementId> <saved:title>
Done: <saved:outcome> | nothing changed
Evidence: <list_requirements → the sent values | list_governance_threads → <saved:threadId>> | reads only
```

## § flow-remove-requirement

## Playbook: remove-requirement
Use when: remove a requirement (obsolete or delete)

How to run this playbook:
- Follow steps in order. CALL sends the shown arguments; RUN executes a command. FOR EACH repeats its indented lines.
- Replace `<input:x>` from You need, `<saved:x>` from SAVE, `<each:x>` from the current item. Whole placeholders retain their JSON type, including numbers, arrays, objects and null; embedded ones are text. Never invent concurrency tokens. `result` is the last call's response.
- IF tests a condition; go to step N jumps forward; go to Answer ends execution.
- ASK waits for the user's answer unless that exact action is already authorized. STOP ends calls and puts its message in Next. Owner-only actions require the owner's order.

### You need
| Input | Where it comes from | If missing |
|---|---|---|
| projectId | the user | STOP. Say: "Which LPM project? (id or name)" |
| requirement | the requirement id or exact title | STOP. Say: "Which requirement? (id or title)" |
| change | "delete" if the user said delete/apagar/deletar, else "obsolete" | "obsolete" |
| reason | the user's words explaining the removal, quoted | "no reason given" |
| ownerOrder | the workspace owner's own words in this conversation ordering this removal, copied word for word (a non-owner's "pode deletar, eu confirmo" is not it) | "none" |

### Steps
Every CALL with no error line: IF it returns an error → STOP. Say: "<tool> failed: <error text>. Nothing was removed."
1. CALL `get_mcp_connection_info` {} [A]
   IF result.credential == "oauth" → STOP. Say: "Removing requirements needs an LPM API key (delete: profile full or custom)."
2. CALL `get_project_scope_resolution_context` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>"} [A]
   SAVE: baselineId, version, baselineCreatedAt = id, version, createdAt of result.currentBaseline
3. CALL `list_requirements` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","baselineId":"<saved:baselineId>"} [A]
   SAVE: requirementId = id of the only item whose id or title == <input:requirement>; title, createdAt = those fields of that item; links = its issueId, linkedIssueIds, linkedCycleIds and linkedMilestoneIds; approved = "yes" if its createdAt <= <saved:baselineCreatedAt>, else "no"
   IF no item or 2+ items match → STOP. Say: "Which requirement? <each matching id and title>"
   IF <saved:approved> == "no" or <input:ownerOrder> != "none" → go to step 7.
4. CALL `list_governance_threads` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","targetType":"requirement","targetId":"<saved:requirementId>"} [A]
   Approved scope and no owner order: never call delete_requirement or update_requirement in this run.
   IF an item has status neither "resolved" nor "closed" → STOP. Say: "Thread <that id> already asks the owner about <saved:requirementId>. Nothing was removed."
5. SAVE: content = this text, filled:
   ```text
   Decision needed: remove requirement <saved:title> (<saved:requirementId>) from approved baseline <saved:version> (<saved:baselineId>)?
   Context: <input:reason>; created <saved:createdAt>, before the baseline (<saved:baselineCreatedAt>); linked to <saved:links>.
   Options:
     A) status obsolete - keeps history and links; reversible
     B) delete - links to activities, cycles and milestones are removed for good; the working-scope delta will not show it
     C) keep it
   Recommendation: A, because it keeps traceability.
   To proceed, the owner replies with the option.
   ```
6. CALL `create_governance_thread` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","targetType":"requirement","targetId":"<saved:requirementId>","title":"Remove requirement <saved:title> from approved scope <saved:version>","content":"<saved:content>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error → STOP. Say: "Thread not opened: <error text>. Ask the workspace owner directly (lpm-governance-decisions). Nothing was removed."
   SAVE: threadId = the id after "ID: "
   VERIFY: CALL `list_governance_threads` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","targetType":"requirement","targetId":"<saved:requirementId>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or no item has id == <saved:threadId> → STOP. Say: "Thread <saved:threadId> is not listed."
   SAVE: outcome = "thread <saved:threadId> opened for the owner; <saved:requirementId> unchanged"; go to Answer.
7. IF <input:change> == "delete" → go to step 10.
8. ASK: "Mark requirement <saved:requirementId> '<saved:title>' as obsolete? It keeps its history and links. Intent: deprecation. (yes/no)" — continue only if the user says yes; otherwise STOP.
9. CALL `update_requirement` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","requirementId":"<saved:requirementId>","status":"obsolete"} [C]
   VERIFY: CALL `list_requirements` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","baselineId":"<saved:baselineId>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or item <saved:requirementId> does not have status "obsolete" → STOP. Say: "<saved:requirementId> is not obsolete."
   SAVE: outcome = "<saved:requirementId> marked obsolete"; go to Answer.
10. ASK: "Delete <saved:title> (<saved:requirementId>)? Its links (<saved:links>) are removed for good and the delta will not show it; status obsolete keeps history. Delete anyway? (yes/no)" — continue only if the user says yes; otherwise STOP.
11. CALL `delete_requirement` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","requirementId":"<saved:requirementId>"} [C]
   VERIFY: CALL `list_requirements` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","baselineId":"<saved:baselineId>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or an item still has id == <saved:requirementId> → STOP. Say: "<saved:requirementId> is still listed."
   SAVE: outcome = "<saved:requirementId> deleted"

### Answer (reply with exactly this block, filled in; write nothing before or after it)
```text
Scope: <input:projectId>; baseline <saved:version> (<saved:baselineId>); requirement <saved:requirementId> <saved:title>
Done: <saved:outcome> | nothing changed
Evidence: list_requirements → createdAt <saved:createdAt> vs baseline <saved:baselineCreatedAt>; <list_governance_threads → <saved:threadId> | list_requirements → the removal> | reads only
Pending: owner decision — the workspace owner | removal to name in the next change-set summary: <saved:requirementId> <saved:title> | none
Next: <the ASK or STOP text that ended the run> | the owner answers in thread <saved:threadId> | none
```
requirement status: pending | in-progress | met | not-met | obsolete. Never claim a removal that a VERIFY did not show; the working-scope delta never shows removals.

   SAVE: groupId = id of the only item whose id or name == <input:group> (ignoring case; empty if none)
   IF <input:action> == "create" and <saved:groupId> is not empty → STOP. Say: "Group '<input:group>' already exists (<saved:groupId>); reuse it."
   IF <input:action> != "create" and <saved:groupId> is empty → STOP. Say: "No single group named '<input:group>' (groups: <each id and name>)."
   IF <input:action> == "rename" → go to step 5.
   IF <input:action> == "delete" → go to step 6.
4. CALL `create_requirement_group` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","name":"<input:group>"} [A] (not idempotent: never retry; rerun this playbook)
   SAVE: groupId = the id after "ID: "
   VERIFY: CALL `list_requirement_groups` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or no item has id == <saved:groupId> → STOP. Say: "Group <saved:groupId> is not listed."
   SAVE: outcome = "group <saved:groupId> '<input:group>' created"; go to Answer.
5. CALL `update_requirement_group` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","groupId":"<saved:groupId>","name":"<input:newName>"} [A]
   VERIFY: CALL `list_requirement_groups` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or item <saved:groupId> does not have name == <input:newName> → STOP. Say: "Group <saved:groupId> does not show the new name."
   SAVE: outcome = "group <saved:groupId> renamed to '<input:newName>'"; go to Answer.
6. CALL `list_requirements` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","baselineId":"<saved:baselineId>","groupId":"<saved:groupId>"} [A]
   SAVE: count = the number of items
7. ASK: "Delete group '<input:group>' (<saved:groupId>)? <saved:count> current requirements (and past baseline copies) become ungrouped, show as changed and can raise materiality. It cannot be restored. (yes/no)" — continue only if the user says yes; otherwise STOP.
8. CALL `delete_requirement_group` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","groupId":"<saved:groupId>"} [C]
   VERIFY: CALL `list_requirement_groups` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or an item still has id == <saved:groupId> → STOP. Say: "Group <saved:groupId> is still listed."
   SAVE: outcome = "group <saved:groupId> deleted; <saved:count> requirements ungrouped"; go to Answer.
9. IF <saved:n> == 0 → STOP. Say: "No requirements are waiting for a baseline (LPM read models can re-attach orphans on read)."
   IF <saved:baselineId> is empty → STOP. Say: "No current baseline: the owner's first-baseline publication attaches them (playbook publish-baseline)."
10. CALL `list_requirements_awaiting_baseline` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","limitCount":100} [A]
   SAVE: titles = "<id> <title>" of each item
11. ASK: "Attach all <saved:n> orphans (<saved:titles>) to baseline <saved:name> <saved:version> (<saved:baselineId>)? All are attached at once; they count as changed and can raise materiality. (yes/no)" — continue only if the user says yes; otherwise STOP.
12. CALL `reconcile_orphan_requirements_into_baseline` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","baselineId":"<saved:baselineId>"} [C]
   VERIFY: CALL `get_project_scope_resolution_context` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or result.requirementsAwaitingBaseline.count != 0 → STOP. Say: "<result.requirementsAwaitingBaseline.count> requirements still have no baseline."
   SAVE: outcome = "<saved:n> orphans attached to <saved:baselineId>; changed now <result.workingScope.changedCount>, materiality <result.publicationGate.materiality>"

### Answer (reply with exactly this block, filled in; write nothing before or after it)
```text
Scope: <input:projectId>; baseline <saved:version> (<saved:baselineId>)
Done: <saved:outcome> | nothing changed
Evidence: <list_requirement_groups → the created, renamed or removed id | scope re-read → awaiting baseline 0> | reads only
Pending: none | a change set for owner review when materiality is medium or high
Next: <the ASK or STOP text that ended the run> | none
```
materiality: none | low | medium | high. Never claim a change that a VERIFY did not show.


## § flow-change-set

## Playbook: change-set
Use when: create a live change set, or move it to review/draft

How to run this playbook:
- Follow steps in order. CALL sends the shown arguments; RUN executes a command. FOR EACH repeats its indented lines.
- Replace `<input:x>` from You need, `<saved:x>` from SAVE, `<each:x>` from the current item. Whole placeholders retain their JSON type, including numbers, arrays, objects and null; embedded ones are text. Never invent concurrency tokens. `result` is the last call's response.
- IF tests a condition; go to step N jumps forward; go to Answer ends execution.
- ASK waits for the user's answer unless that exact action is already authorized. STOP ends calls and puts its message in Next. Owner-only actions require the owner's order.
- VERIFY must pass before reporting success. Fill the Answer block in the user's language; copy IDs exactly. Secrets never enter the reply. **Your entire reply is ONLY the Answer block — no other text.**

### You need
| Input | Where it comes from | If missing |
|---|---|---|
| projectId | the user | STOP. Say: "Which LPM project? (id or name)" |
| action | "create", "review" (create if needed, then send to review) or "draft", from the user's words | STOP. Say: "Create the change set, send it to review, or move it back to draft?" |
| changeSet | the change set id or exact title the user named | "none" |
| title | the title the user gave | "Scope change since the current baseline" |
| summary | what changes and why, in the user's words | "none" |
| removals | ids and titles of requirements removed or deleted in this work (the delta never shows them) | "none in this run; the delta cannot show removals" |

### Steps
Every CALL with no error line: IF it returns an error → STOP. Say: "<tool> failed: <error text>. Nothing else was changed."
1. CALL `get_mcp_connection_info` {} [A]
   IF result.credential == "oauth" → STOP. Say: "Change sets need an LPM API key; a ChatGPT/Claude connector can only read them."
2. CALL `get_project_scope_resolution_context` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>"} [A]
   SAVE: affected = result.workingScope.affectedCount; reviewNeeded = result.publicationGate.requiresFormalReview; materiality = result.publicationGate.materiality
3. CALL `list_change_sets` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>"} [A]
   SAVE: sets = id, title, status, createdAt, approvedAt, workingScopeSnapshot.affectedRequirementIds and scopeProposal (set or not) of each item
   IF <input:changeSet> != "none" → SAVE: csId = id of the only item whose id or title == <input:changeSet> (empty if 0 or 2+ match); go to step 9.
   IF <input:action> is neither "create" nor "review" → STOP. Say: "Which change set? <each id, title, status>"
   IF <saved:affected> == 0 → STOP. Say: "The working scope has no delta: no change set is needed."
4. CALL `list_working_scope_delta_entities` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","changeType":"added","limitCount":100} [A]
   SAVE: deltaIds = requirementId of each item; added = title of each item; last = the latest changedAt
5. CALL `list_working_scope_delta_entities` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","changeType":"changed","limitCount":100} [A]
   SAVE: deltaIds = <saved:deltaIds> plus requirementId of each item; changed = title of each item; last = the latest changedAt of steps 4 and 5
6. SAVE: reuse = id of the first item of <saved:sets> with no scopeProposal, affectedRequirementIds equal to <saved:deltaIds> (any order) and status "draft" or "in-review" with createdAt not before <saved:last>, or status "approved" with approvedAt not before <saved:last> (empty if none)
   IF <saved:reuse> is not empty → SAVE: csId = <saved:reuse>; go to step 9.
   IF <saved:reviewNeeded> == false → ASK: "No change set is needed to publish (materiality <saved:materiality>); the gate will never match one. Create it anyway? (yes/no)" — continue only if the user says yes; otherwise STOP.
7. SAVE: why = <input:summary>, else "Adds: <saved:added>. Changes: <saved:changed>."; text = "<saved:why> Removed or deleted: <input:removals>"
8. CALL `create_project_change_set_from_resolution` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","title":"<input:title>","summary":"<saved:text>"} [A] (never add sourceBaselineId)
   IF the call returns an error → STOP. Say: "Not created: <error text>. It is not idempotent: rerun this playbook (step 6 finds a set that was created) instead of retrying."
   SAVE: csId = result.changeSetId
   VERIFY: CALL `get_change_set` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","changeSetId":"<saved:csId>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or result.status != "draft" → STOP. Say: "Change set <saved:csId> is not readable as draft."
   IF <input:action> == "create" → SAVE: csStatus = result.status; csTitle = result.title; go to Answer.
9. CALL `get_change_set` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","changeSetId":"<saved:csId>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error → STOP. Say: "Change set <input:changeSet> not found: <error text>."
   SAVE: csStatus = result.status; csTitle = result.title
   IF result.scopeProposal is set → switch to playbook proposal.
   IF <input:action> == "create" or (<input:action> == "review" and <saved:csStatus> == "in-review") → go to Answer.
   IF <input:action> == "review" and <saved:csStatus> != "draft" → STOP. Say: "Only a draft goes to review; <saved:csId> is <saved:csStatus> (an approved or rejected set goes back to draft first)."
   IF <input:action> == "draft" and <saved:csStatus> is neither "in-review", "approved" nor "rejected" → STOP. Say: "<saved:csId> is <saved:csStatus>; it cannot go back to draft."
   SAVE: target = "in-review" if <input:action> == "review", else "draft"
10. ASK: "Move change set <saved:csTitle> (<saved:csId>) from <saved:csStatus> to <saved:target>? (yes/no)" — continue only if the user says yes; otherwise STOP.
11. CALL `update_project_change_set_status` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","changeSetId":"<saved:csId>","status":"<saved:target>"} [C]
   VERIFY: CALL `get_change_set` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","changeSetId":"<saved:csId>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or result.status != <saved:target> → STOP. Say: "<saved:csId> is <result.status>, not <saved:target>."
   SAVE: csStatus = result.status; go to Answer.

### Answer (reply with exactly this block, filled in; write nothing before or after it)
```text
Scope: <input:projectId>; change set <saved:csId> <saved:csTitle> (live)
Done: <created | moved to <saved:target> | nothing changed>; status <saved:csStatus>
Evidence: get_change_set → status <saved:csStatus>; materiality <saved:materiality> | reads only
Pending: none | owner review — the workspace owner | <removals named in the summary>
Next: <the ASK or STOP text that ended the run> | the owner approves or rejects <saved:csId> (playbook change-set-decision) | none
```
status: draft | in-review | approved | rejected | published, from your last get_change_set. Never claim a check that a step above did not run and pass.


## § flow-change-set-decision

## Playbook: change-set-decision
Use when: the owner approves or rejects a change set

How to run this playbook:
- Follow steps in order. CALL sends the shown arguments; RUN executes a command. FOR EACH repeats its indented lines.
- Replace `<input:x>` from You need, `<saved:x>` from SAVE, `<each:x>` from the current item. Whole placeholders retain their JSON type, including numbers, arrays, objects and null; embedded ones are text. Never invent concurrency tokens. `result` is the last call's response.
- IF tests a condition; go to step N jumps forward; go to Answer ends execution.
- ASK waits for the user's answer unless that exact action is already authorized. STOP ends calls and puts its message in Next. Owner-only actions require the owner's order.
- VERIFY must pass before reporting success. Fill the Answer block in the user's language; copy IDs exactly. Secrets never enter the reply. **Your entire reply is ONLY the Answer block — no other text.**

### You need
| Input | Where it comes from | If missing |
|---|---|---|
| projectId | the user | STOP. Say: "Which LPM project? (id or name)" |
| changeSet | the change set id or exact title | STOP. Say: "Which change set? (id or title)" |
| decision | "approve" or "reject", from the owner's words | STOP. Say: "Approve or reject?" |
| ownerOrder | the workspace owner's own message in this conversation deciding this change set, copied word for word (a user's "yes" or your judgment is not it) | "none" |

### Steps
Every CALL with no error line: IF it returns an error → STOP. Say: "<tool> failed: <error text>. Nothing was decided."
1. CALL `get_mcp_connection_info` {} [A]
   IF result.credential == "oauth" → STOP. Say: "Recording a change-set decision needs an LPM API key."
2. CALL `get_project_scope_resolution_context` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>"} [A]
   SAVE: reviewNeeded = result.publicationGate.requiresFormalReview
3. CALL `list_change_sets` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>"} [A]
   SAVE: csId = id of the only item whose id or title == <input:changeSet>
   IF no item or 2+ items match → STOP. Say: "Which change set? <each id, title, status>"
4. CALL `get_change_set` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","changeSetId":"<saved:csId>"} [A]
   SAVE: csStatus = result.status; csTitle = result.title; csReview = result.reviewPolicy.requiresFormalReview; materiality = result.reviewPolicy.materiality; fingerprint = result.scopeProposal.contentFingerprint (empty if no scopeProposal); target = "approved" if <input:decision> == "approve", else "rejected"
   IF <saved:csStatus> != "in-review" and (<input:decision> == "reject" or <saved:csStatus> != "draft" or <saved:csReview> == true or <saved:fingerprint> is not empty) → STOP. Say: "<saved:csId> is <saved:csStatus>: it must be in-review before the owner decides (material sets and proposals always need review)."
   IF <saved:fingerprint> is not empty → go to step 7.
5. ONLY IF the owner ordered it in this conversation (quote the order); otherwise STOP. Say: "Owner: approve or reject change set <saved:csTitle> (<saved:csId>, materiality <saved:materiality>)? Nothing was changed."
6. CALL `update_project_change_set_status` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","changeSetId":"<saved:csId>","status":"<saved:target>"} [O]
   VERIFY: CALL `get_change_set` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","changeSetId":"<saved:csId>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or result.status != <saved:target> → STOP. Say: "<saved:csId> is <result.status>, not <saved:target>."
   SAVE: csStatus = result.status
   VERIFY: CALL `get_project_scope_resolution_context` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or (<saved:target> == "approved" and <saved:reviewNeeded> == true and result.publicationGate.matchedApprovedChangeSetId != <saved:csId>) → STOP. Say: "Approved, but the gate does not match <saved:csId>: scope or linked work changed after it was frozen. Create a new change set and review it again."
   SAVE: kind = "live"; go to Answer.
7. ONLY IF the owner ordered it in this conversation (quote the order); otherwise STOP. Say: "Owner: approve or reject proposal <saved:csTitle> (<saved:csId>)? Nothing was changed."
8. CALL `update_change_set` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","changeSetId":"<saved:csId>","status":"<saved:target>","expectedProposalFingerprint":"<saved:fingerprint>"} [O] (send only these 4 keys)
   IF the call returns an error → STOP. Say: "Not decided: <error text>. 'Proposal or base changed' means a fresh proposal is needed."
   VERIFY: CALL `get_change_set` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","changeSetId":"<saved:csId>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or result.status != <saved:target> → STOP. Say: "<saved:csId> is <result.status>, not <saved:target>."
   SAVE: csStatus = result.status; kind = "proposal"

### Answer (reply with exactly this block, filled in; write nothing before or after it)
```text
Scope: <input:projectId>; change set <saved:csId> <saved:csTitle> (<saved:kind>)
Done: <decision recorded: <saved:target> | nothing changed>; status <saved:csStatus>
Evidence: owner order "<input:ownerOrder>"; get_change_set → status <saved:csStatus> | reads only

```

## § flow-proposal

## Playbook: proposal
Use when: propose rewrites or copies (live scope untouched)

How to run this playbook:
- Follow steps in order. CALL sends the shown arguments; RUN executes a command. FOR EACH repeats its indented lines.
- Replace `<input:x>` from You need, `<saved:x>` from SAVE, `<each:x>` from the current item. Whole placeholders retain their JSON type, including numbers, arrays, objects and null; embedded ones are text. Never invent concurrency tokens. `result` is the last call's response.
- IF tests a condition; go to step N jumps forward; go to Answer ends execution.
- ASK waits for the user's answer unless that exact action is already authorized. STOP ends calls and puts its message in Next. Owner-only actions require the owner's order.
- VERIFY must pass before reporting success. Fill the Answer block in the user's language; copy IDs exactly. Secrets never enter the reply. **Your entire reply is ONLY the Answer block — no other text.**

### You need
| Input | Where it comes from | If missing |
|---|---|---|
| projectId | the user | STOP. Say: "Which LPM project? (id or name)" |
| kind | "revisions" (new descriptions for current requirements) or "additions" (copies of existing requirements) | STOP. Say: "Rewrite descriptions of current requirements, or copy existing requirements?" |
| items | revisions: each requirement (id or exact title) with its new description; additions: each source requirement (id or exact title) | STOP. Say: "Which requirements, and (for rewrites) the new description of each?" |
| sourceProjectId | additions: the project the copied requirements come from | "none" (same project) |
| changeSet | an existing proposal id the user named | "none" |
| action | "create" or "review" (create if needed, then send to review) | "review" |
| title | the title the user gave | "Scope proposal" |
| summary | what changes and why | STOP. Say: "In one sentence: what changes and why?" |

### Steps
Every CALL with no error line: IF it returns an error → STOP. Say: "<tool> failed: <error text>. Live requirements were not touched."
1. CALL `get_mcp_connection_info` {} [A]
   IF result.credential == "oauth" → STOP. Say: "Proposals need an LPM API key with project manage access."
2. CALL `list_requirement_baselines` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>"} [A]
   SAVE: baselineId = id of the only item with isCurrent == true
   IF no item or 2+ items have isCurrent == true → STOP. Say: "A proposal needs exactly one current baseline; report this to the owner."
   IF <input:changeSet> != "none" → SAVE: csId = <input:changeSet>; go to step 10.
   IF <input:kind> == "revisions" → SAVE: src = <input:projectId>; srcBaselineId = <saved:baselineId>; go to step 5.
3. SAVE: src = <input:sourceProjectId> if it is not "none", else <input:projectId>
4. CALL `list_requirement_baselines` {"projectId":"<saved:src>"} [A]
   SAVE: srcBaselineId = id of the only item with isCurrent == true
   IF no item matches → STOP. Say: "Project <saved:src> has no current baseline to copy from."
5. CALL `list_requirements` {"projectId":"<saved:src>","baselineId":"<saved:srcBaselineId>"} [A]
   SAVE: rows = for each entry of <input:items>, the only item whose id or title == that entry
   IF an entry matches no item or 2+ items → STOP. Say: "Which requirement is '<that entry>'? (id)"
6. SAVE: proposal = one JSON object, never both keys:
     revisions → {"revisions":[{"requirementId":"<row id>","title":"<row title, exact>","beforeDescription":"<row description, exact>","description":"<the new description>"}, …]}
     additions → {"additions":[{"key":"<row id>","title":"<row title>","description":"<row description>","type":"<row type>","source":{"projectId":"<saved:src>","baselineId":"<saved:srcBaselineId>","requirementId":"<row id>"},"linkedIssueIds":[]}, …]}
   IF a new description equals its beforeDescription → STOP. Say: "The new description of <that requirementId> is the same as the current one."
7. CALL `create_change_set` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","title":"<input:title>","summary":"<input:summary>","sourceBaselineId":"<saved:baselineId>","requirementProposal":"<saved:proposal>","dryRun":true} [A] (dry run: nothing is written)
   SAVE: fingerprint = result.draft.scopeProposal.contentFingerprint; materiality = result.draft.reviewPolicy.materiality
   VERIFY: CALL `list_change_sets` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or an item with id "proposal-<saved:fingerprint>" has status "approved" or "published" → STOP. Say: "This exact proposal already exists as proposal-<saved:fingerprint> (<that status>)."
8. ASK: "Create proposal '<input:title>' (<input:kind>, <the number of rows> requirements, materiality <saved:materiality>) on baseline <saved:baselineId>? Live requirements are not changed. (yes/no)" — continue only if the user says yes; otherwise STOP.
9. CALL `create_change_set` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","title":"<input:title>","summary":"<input:summary>","sourceBaselineId":"<saved:baselineId>","requirementProposal":"<saved:proposal>","expectedProposalFingerprint":"<saved:fingerprint>"} [A] (the same arguments as step 7, without dryRun)
   SAVE: csId = result.id; reused = result.reused
   VERIFY: CALL `get_change_set` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","changeSetId":"<saved:csId>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or result.scopeProposal.contentFingerprint != <saved:fingerprint> → STOP. Say: "Proposal <saved:csId> does not show fingerprint <saved:fingerprint>."
10. CALL `get_change_set` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","changeSetId":"<saved:csId>"} [A]
   SAVE: csStatus = result.status; fingerprint = result.scopeProposal.contentFingerprint (empty if no scopeProposal)
   IF <saved:fingerprint> is empty → switch to playbook change-set.
   IF <input:action> == "create" or <saved:csStatus> == "in-review" → go to Answer.
   IF <saved:csStatus> != "draft" → STOP. Say: "<saved:csId> is <saved:csStatus>; only a draft goes to review."
11. ASK: "Send proposal <saved:csId> to the owner's review? (yes/no)" — continue only if the user says yes; otherwise STOP.
12. CALL `update_change_set` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","changeSetId":"<saved:csId>","status":"in-review","expectedProposalFingerprint":"<saved:fingerprint>"} [C] (send only these 4 keys)
   IF the call returns an error → STOP. Say: "Not sent to review: <error text>. 'Proposal or base changed' means: build a fresh proposal (rerun this playbook)."
   VERIFY: CALL `get_change_set` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","changeSetId":"<saved:csId>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or result.status != "in-review" → STOP. Say: "<saved:csId> is <result.status>, not in-review."
   SAVE: csStatus = result.status

### Answer (reply with exactly this block, filled in; write nothing before or after it)
```text
Scope: <input:projectId>; proposal <saved:csId> on baseline <saved:baselineId>
Done: <proposal created (reused <saved:reused>) | sent to review | nothing changed>; status <saved:csStatus>; live requirements unchanged
Evidence: dry-run fingerprint <saved:fingerprint>, materiality <saved:materiality>; get_change_set → status <saved:csStatus> | reads only
Pending: none | owner review — the workspace owner
Next: <the ASK or STOP text that ended the run> | the owner approves or rejects it (playbook change-set-decision) | none
```
status: draft | in-review | approved | rejected | published, from your last get_change_set. Never claim a check that a step above did not run and pass.


## § flow-publish-baseline

## Playbook: publish-baseline
Use when: publish a baseline on the owner's order

How to run this playbook:
- Follow steps in order. CALL sends the shown arguments; RUN executes a command. FOR EACH repeats its indented lines.
- Replace `<input:x>` from You need, `<saved:x>` from SAVE, `<each:x>` from the current item. Whole placeholders retain their JSON type, including numbers, arrays, objects and null; embedded ones are text. Never invent concurrency tokens. `result` is the last call's response.
- IF tests a condition; go to step N jumps forward; go to Answer ends execution.
- ASK waits for the user's answer unless that exact action is already authorized. STOP ends calls and puts its message in Next. Owner-only actions require the owner's order.

### You need
| Input | Where it comes from | If missing |
|---|---|---|
| projectId | the user | STOP. Say: "Which LPM project? (id or name)" |
| name | the baseline name the owner gave | STOP. Say: "Which name for the new baseline?" |
| version | the new version the owner gave; never invent one | STOP. Say: "Which version for the new baseline?" |
| changeSetId | the change set or proposal id named | "none" |
| ownerOrder | the workspace owner's own words ordering it in this conversation, verbatim (no one else's "yes") | "none" |

   IF result.credential == "oauth" → STOP. Say: "Publishing needs an LPM API key."
2. CALL `get_project_scope_resolution_context` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>"} [A]
   SAVE: oldId = result.currentBaseline.id (empty if null); review = result.publicationGate.requiresFormalReview; matchedId = result.publicationGate.matchedApprovedChangeSetId (empty if null); materiality = result.publicationGate.materiality; orphans = result.requirementsAwaitingBaseline.count
   IF result.publicationGate.shouldBlockPublication == true and <saved:matchedId> is empty → STOP. Say: "Blocked (materiality <saved:materiality>, <result.publicationGate.reasonCodes>): the owner must approve a matching change set."

   Always make this call.
   SAVE: delta = requirementId and changedAt of each item
5. CALL `list_working_scope_delta_entities` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","changeType":"changed","limitCount":100} [A]
   Always make this call.
   SAVE: delta = <saved:delta> plus requirementId and changedAt of each item
6. SAVE: csId = <input:changeSetId> if not "none", else <saved:matchedId>; mode = "live"; note = "no change set needed (materiality <saved:materiality>)"
   IF <saved:csId> is empty → go to step 8.
7. CALL `get_change_set` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","changeSetId":"<saved:csId>"} [A]
   SAVE: fp = result.scopeProposal.contentFingerprint (empty if absent); approvedAt = result.approvedAt; note = "change set <saved:csId>"
   IF result.status != "approved" → STOP. Say: "<saved:csId> is <result.status>, not approved."
   IF <saved:fp> is not empty and (result.approvedContentFingerprint != <saved:fp> or <saved:orphans> > 0) → STOP. Say: "Proposal <saved:csId>: not approved in this form, or <saved:orphans> orphans."
   IF <saved:fp> is not empty → SAVE: mode = "proposal"; go to step 8.
   IF <saved:review> == true and <saved:csId> != <saved:matchedId> → STOP. Say: "<saved:csId> no longer matches the scope: new change set, review again."
   IF <saved:review> == true and an item of <saved:delta> has no changedAt or one later than <saved:approvedAt> → STOP. Say: "<that requirementId> changed after <saved:csId> was approved: new change set, review again."
8. SAVE: notes = "Owner order: '<input:ownerOrder>'; <saved:note>"
   IF <saved:mode> == "proposal" → go to step 11.
9. ONLY IF the owner ordered it in this conversation (quote the order); otherwise STOP. Say: "Owner: publish baseline <input:name> <input:version> (<saved:note>)? (publish / do not)"
10. CALL `publish_baseline_from_working_scope` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","name":"<input:name>","version":"<input:version>","publicationNotes":"<saved:notes>"} [O] (no changeSetId, no isCurrent)
   IF the call returns an error → STOP. Say: "Not confirmed: <error text>. Do not retry: rerun this playbook."
   SAVE: newId = result.baseline.id
   VERIFY: CALL `get_project_scope_resolution_context` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or result.currentBaseline.id != <saved:newId> or result.workingScope.addedCount != 0 or result.workingScope.changedCount != 0 → STOP. Say: "<saved:newId> is not current with an empty delta."
   SAVE: added = 0; changed = 0; go to step 13.
11. ONLY IF the owner ordered it in this conversation (quote the order); otherwise STOP. Say: "Owner: publish approved proposal <saved:csId> as baseline <input:name> <input:version>? (publish / do not)"
12. CALL `publish_baseline_from_working_scope` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","name":"<input:name>","version":"<input:version>","changeSetId":"<saved:csId>","expectedProposalFingerprint":"<saved:fp>","publicationNotes":"<saved:notes>"} [O]
   IF the call returns an error → STOP. Say: "Not published: <error text>. Do not retry."
   SAVE: newId = result.baseline.id
   VERIFY: CALL `get_project_scope_resolution_context` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or result.currentBaseline.id != <saved:newId> → STOP. Say: "<saved:newId> is not the current baseline."
   SAVE: added = result.workingScope.addedCount; changed = result.workingScope.changedCount
13. CALL `get_change_set` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","changeSetId":"<saved:csId>"} [A] (always, unless <saved:csId> is empty)
   SAVE: csAfter = result.status
   IF (<saved:review> == true or <saved:mode> == "proposal") and (<saved:csAfter> != "published" or result.publicationBaselineId != <saved:newId>) → STOP. Say: "<saved:csId> is <saved:csAfter>, not published on <saved:newId>; never call publish_change_set."
14. CALL `list_requirements` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","baselineId":"<saved:newId>"} [A]
   SAVE: count = the number of items
15. CALL `list_requirement_baselines` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>"} [A]
   IF not exactly one item has isCurrent == true, or it is not <saved:newId> → STOP. Say: "<saved:newId> is not the only current baseline."

### Answer (reply with exactly this block, filled in; write nothing before or after it)
```text
Scope: <input:projectId>; baseline <input:name> <input:version>
Done: <baseline <saved:newId> published, current (was <saved:oldId>) | nothing published>; <change set <saved:csId> <saved:csAfter> | <saved:note>>
Evidence: owner order "<input:ownerOrder>"; re-read: current <saved:newId>, added <saved:added>, changed <saved:changed>; <saved:count> requirements | reads only
Pending: none | <the failed check> — <who must act>
Next: <the ASK or STOP text that ended the run> | plan the new scope's work (lpm-plan-work) | none
```
change-set status: draft | in-review | approved | rejected | published, from step 13. Never claim a check that a step above did not run and pass.


## § flow-baseline-records

## Playbook: baseline-records
Use when: rename, restore or delete a baseline (owner)

How to run this playbook:
- Follow steps in order. CALL sends the shown arguments; RUN executes a command. FOR EACH repeats its indented lines.
- Replace `<input:x>` from You need, `<saved:x>` from SAVE, `<each:x>` from the current item. Whole placeholders retain their JSON type, including numbers, arrays, objects and null; embedded ones are text. Never invent concurrency tokens. `result` is the last call's response.
- IF tests a condition; go to step N jumps forward; go to Answer ends execution.
- ASK waits for the user's answer unless that exact action is already authorized. STOP ends calls and puts its message in Next. Owner-only actions require the owner's order.
- VERIFY must pass before reporting success. Fill the Answer block in the user's language; copy IDs exactly. Secrets never enter the reply. **Your entire reply is ONLY the Answer block — no other text.**

### You need
| Input | Where it comes from | If missing |
|---|---|---|
| projectId | the user | STOP. Say: "Which LPM project? (id or name)" |
| action | "rename", "restore" or "delete", from the owner's words | STOP. Say: "Rename, restore as current, or delete the baseline?" |
| baseline | the baseline id, name or version | STOP. Say: "Which baseline? (id, name or version)" |
| newName | the new name, only for "rename" | "none" |
| newVersion | the new version, only for "rename" | "none" |
| ownerOrder | the workspace owner's own message in this conversation ordering this exact action, copied word for word | "none" |

### Steps
Every CALL with no error line: IF it returns an error → STOP. Say: "<tool> failed: <error text>. Nothing was changed."
1. CALL `get_mcp_connection_info` {} [A]
   IF result.credential == "oauth" → STOP. Say: "Baseline records need an LPM API key (delete: profile full or custom)."
2. CALL `list_requirement_baselines` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>"} [A]
   SAVE: baselineId = id of the only item whose id, name or version == <input:baseline>; name, version, isCurrent = those fields of that item
   IF no item or 2+ items match → STOP. Say: "Which baseline? <each id, name, version, isCurrent>"
   SAVE: sendName = <input:newName> if not "none", else <saved:name>; sendVersion = <input:newVersion> if not "none", else <saved:version>
   IF <input:action> == "restore" and <saved:isCurrent> == true → STOP. Say: "<saved:baselineId> is already current."
   IF <input:action> == "restore" → go to step 5.
   IF <input:action> == "delete" → go to step 7.
3. ONLY IF the owner ordered it in this conversation (quote the order); otherwise STOP. Say: "Owner: rename baseline <saved:name> <saved:version> to <saved:sendName> <saved:sendVersion>? Nothing was changed."
4. CALL `update_requirement_baseline` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","baselineId":"<saved:baselineId>","name":"<saved:sendName>","version":"<saved:sendVersion>"} [O] (never send isCurrent false)
   VERIFY: CALL `list_requirement_baselines` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or item <saved:baselineId> does not have name <saved:sendName> and version <saved:sendVersion> → STOP. Say: "<saved:baselineId> does not show the new name or version."
   SAVE: outcome = "baseline <saved:baselineId> renamed to <saved:sendName> <saved:sendVersion>"; go to Answer.
5. ONLY IF the owner ordered it in this conversation (quote the order); otherwise STOP. Say: "Owner: restore baseline <saved:name> <saved:version> as current? The publication gate still applies. Nothing was changed."
6. CALL `update_requirement_baseline` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","baselineId":"<saved:baselineId>","isCurrent":true} [O]
   IF the call returns an error → STOP. Say: "Not restored: <error text>. 'Material baseline publication requires an approved change set' means the owner must approve a matching change set first."
   VERIFY: CALL `list_requirement_baselines` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or the items with isCurrent == true are not exactly <saved:baselineId> → STOP. Say: "<saved:baselineId> is not the only current baseline."
   SAVE: outcome = "baseline <saved:baselineId> restored as current"; go to Answer.
7. CALL `list_requirements` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","baselineId":"<saved:baselineId>"} [A]
   SAVE: n = the number of items
8. ASK: "Delete baseline <saved:name> <saved:version> with <saved:n> requirements? They are hard-deleted, linked work loses its baseline, and if it is current the newest other baseline becomes current without the gate. It cannot be restored. (yes/no)" — continue only if the user says yes; otherwise STOP.
9. ONLY IF the owner ordered it in this conversation (quote the order); otherwise STOP. Say: "Owner: delete baseline <saved:name> <saved:version> (<saved:n> requirements)? Nothing was deleted."
10. CALL `delete_requirement_baseline` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","baselineId":"<saved:baselineId>"} [O]
   VERIFY: CALL `list_requirement_baselines` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or an item still has id == <saved:baselineId> → STOP. Say: "<saved:baselineId> is still listed."
   SAVE: outcome = "baseline <saved:baselineId> deleted (<saved:n> requirements)"

### Answer (reply with exactly this block, filled in; write nothing before or after it)
```text
Scope: <input:projectId>; baseline <saved:baselineId> <saved:name> <saved:version>
Done: <saved:outcome> | nothing changed
Evidence: owner order "<input:ownerOrder>"; list_requirement_baselines → <the new values | the new current | the id is gone> | reads only
Pending: none | owner decision — the workspace owner
Next: <the ASK or STOP text that ended the run> | none
```
Never use isCurrent false and never create a baseline with create_requirement_baseline here. Never claim a change that a VERIFY did not show.
